title: Swimmer Gian Santos to compete at Asian Games, eyes 2028 Olympics
summary: Fil-American swimmer Gian Christopher Santos is heading to his first Asian Games with a Philippine record under his belt and plenty of momentum from a breakthrough summer in Southern California.
